correctness.rationale: The graph is defined without ambiguity by nine affine points and nine lines, and its entire 216-element automorphism group is derived via column preservation and point-line duality. Exact complete enumeration of 2598 independent subsets yields boundary ranks mod two (17,109,329,472,274,74,16,2); the rational-field rank inequality and Euler characteristic 11 force only rank-ten reduced rational homology in degree four. Exact signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz sums over all 216 automorphisms yield character norm squared two, identity trace ten, vertical translation trace one, and zero global invariants. The order-three subgroup is normal by explicit conjugation and gives nonzero rational projectors of dimensions four and six. Orthogonality and total norm two force both constituents to be absolutely irreducible. The packaged standard-library verifier was executed successfully after creating the exact file; all finite computations and comparison tallies passed. Mod-two data are not misused to assert integral torsion vanishing.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical cubic symmetric incidence graph. Earlier work gave nonequivariant wedge homotopy and only one cyclic action, neither resolving how all 216 symmetries act. A complete ten-dimensional rational module splitting into two absolutely irreducible summands of dimensions four and six, canonically distinguished by a normal ternary translation, is a substantive equivariant topological invariant. It detects distinct order-three symmetry behaviors and vanishing global invariants not inferable from ordinary Betti numbers or the prior restricted character. The 216-element exact character calculation is naturally motivated by the full symmetry group and is not an arbitrary numerical slice.
